profile.name: USB4000光纤光谱仪
profile.description: 一款紧凑型光纤光谱仪，通过光纤采集样品或光源的光谱并经USB连接到计算机。常用于实验室中的吸收、发射、透射和光源光谱测量，以及一般光学表征。
profile.description_en: A compact fiber optic spectrometer that collects spectra from samples or light sources through an optical fiber and connects to a computer via USB. It is commonly used in laboratories for absorption, emission, transmission, and light-source spectral measurements, as well as general optical characterization.

A compact fiber optic spectrometer that collects spectra from samples or light sources through an optical fiber and connects to a computer via USB. It is commonly used in laboratories for absorption, emission, transmission, and light-source spectral measurements, as well as general optical characterization.
